description: Produce a gap-free hourly temperature series per IoT device between each device's first and last reading. For hours without a reading, carry the last observed value forward (LOCF), but only for at most 3 consecutive missing hours; beyond that the value is NULL until the next real reading. If a device has several readings in the same hour, use the latest one. Output columns: device_id (STRING), hour_ts (TIMESTAMP, truncated to the hour, UTC), temperature (FLOAT64), fill_status (STRING: 'observed', 'filled', or 'missing'). Sort by device_id, hour_ts.

reading_ts.description: UTC reading time (not aligned to the hour)

edge_cases: Two readings in hour 00 resolve to the later one (20.0)
Hours 03, 04, 05 are filled (3 hours); hour 06 exceeds the carry limit and is NULL
No rows are generated before the first or after the last reading of a device
Each device has its own hour spine; devices must not fill from each other
common_failure_modes: FM4: LAST_VALUE(temperature IGNORE NULLS) without an explicit ROWS frame, or LAG without IGNORE NULLS, fills only one hour
FM2: Unlimited forward fill ignores the 3-hour cap and hides sensor outages
FM3: Generating one global hour spine cross-joined to devices emits rows outside a device's own range
